Historical rows were joined by printed labels and manually corrected for actual layout differences. Runtime uses only retained historical mappings and SHA-256-pinned bytes. No runtime current-year offset or URL substitution.

parent_commands: bun -e 'import {buildHistoricalPdfBytes} from "./forms/f1040/historical/pdf/builder.ts"; import {syntheticFiler,syntheticPaperPending,syntheticMixedStockRental} from "./forms/f1040/historical/pdf/fixtures.ts"; for (const year of [2021,2022,2023,2024] as const) { await Bun.write(`/tmp/historical-${year}.pdf`,await buildHistoricalPdfBytes(year,syntheticPaperPending(year),syntheticFiler)); await Bun.write(`/tmp/historical-mixed-${year}.pdf`,await buildHistoricalPdfBytes(year,syntheticMixedStockRental(year),syntheticFiler)); }'

bun -e 'import {executeF1040Return} from "./forms/f1040/2025/return-processing/execute_return.ts"; import {buildHistoricalPdfBytes} from "./forms/f1040/historical/pdf/builder.ts"; import {syntheticFiler,syntheticPub974Inputs} from "./forms/f1040/historical/pdf/fixtures.ts"; for(const year of [2021,2022,2023,2024] as const){const result=executeF1040Return(syntheticPub974Inputs(year),{taxYear:year,formType:"f1040"}); if(result.diagnostics.length)throw Error(JSON.stringify(result.diagnostics)); await Bun.write(`/tmp/historical-pub974-${year}.pdf`,await buildHistoricalPdfBytes(year,result.pending,syntheticFiler));}'
